title: Mitigating Semantic Drift: Evaluating LLMs’ Efficacy in Psychotherapy through MI Dialogue Summarization
reasoning: The paper evaluates LLMs based on clinical psychotherapy constructs (MITI framework), such as empathy and a non-judgmental attitude. While these are professional values in healthcare, the study is a performance evaluation of dialogue summarization and clinical integrity rather than a benchmark for religion, faith, or general moral/ethical systems.
